title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Faricimab in Participants With Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration (TENAYA)
text: TENAYA is a registered phase 3 study of faricimab against aflibercept in treatment naive neovascular age related macular degeneration, the registry record behind one of the two pivotal trials reported in the Lancet in 2022.
sections: TENAYA is a registered phase 3 study of faricimab against aflibercept in treatment naive neovascular age related macular degeneration, the registry record behind one of the two pivotal trials reported in the Lancet in 2022.
verification: NCT number confirmed on ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-10-30; recruitment status and sites not verified in this snapshot.

title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Faricimab in Participants With Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration (LUCERNE)
text: LUCERNE is the second registered phase 3 study of faricimab against aflibercept in treatment naive neovascular age related macular degeneration, run in parallel with TENAYA.

title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Faricimab in Participants With Diabetic Macular Edema (YOSEMITE)
text: YOSEMITE is a registered phase 3 study of faricimab against aflibercept in diabetic macular oedema, one of the two pivotal trials behind the faricimab appraisal for diabetic macular oedema.

title: Ranibizumab in Subjects With Minimally Classic or Occult Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration (MARINA)
text: MARINA is the registry record for the phase 3 sham controlled study of monthly ranibizumab in minimally classic or occult neovascular age related macular degeneration.
